description: Search Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) by keyword. Returns authorized subject headings and their URIs, ranked by relevance with a heading that exactly matches the query first; a partial word with no keyword match returns the headings that begin with it. Use the returned label as the subject filter in libofcongress_search_items — LCSH uses precise, standardized terms that differ from natural language (e.g., "World War, 1939-1945" not "World War II"; "Aerial photography" not "Photography, Aerial"). Running this tool before a subject-filtered libofcongress_search_items dramatically improves result quality.

limit.description: Maximum number of subject headings to return. Default 10. A call returns at most 50 headings; a larger limit (up to 1000) returns up to 50.

query.description: Keyword or partial subject heading to search for (e.g., "civil war", "immigration", "jazz").

name: libofcongress_search_subjects

cap.description: The heading limit applied to this response.

effectiveLimit.description: The heading count actually applied when limit exceeded the per-call cap of 50. Absent when limit was within the cap.

effectiveQuery.description: The query as submitted to the id.loc.gov subject suggest endpoint, after trimming.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `request_timed_out`: The Library of Congress subject heading service did not respond within the 50-second request budget. `upstream_unavailable`: The Library of Congress subject heading service could not be reached, or answered with an error status, an HTML page, or an unreadable response instead of its JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no heading matched; how many headings matched when more exist than this response holds; disclosure of a capped limit. Absent when every matching heading was returned.

shown.description: Number of subject headings returned in this response.

subjects.description: LCSH subject headings matching the query, ordered by relevance, an exact match first. To see how many LOC items carry a heading, pass its label as the libofcongress_search_items subject filter and read total.

items.description: A single LCSH subject heading record.

label.description: Standardized LCSH heading — use this exact string in the libofcongress_search_items subject filter.

uri.description: Stable LOC URI identifying this subject heading in the authority file.

truncated.description: True when more headings match than this response holds. Refine the query to see others, or raise limit when it is below 50.

title: Search LC Subject Headings
